Zero HOT setups this morning? Are you kidding me? Not even a WARM one? This market is either the calm before the storm or a temple of boredom trying to lull us to sleep. Either way, the squeeze scoreboard says neutral, and that tells me all I need to know—sentiment is in no man’s land, and the bears? They’ve got nothing.

The macro backdrop isn’t giving us much to chew on, and when the tape gets quiet like this, it's a sign. **When nothing’s moving, that *is* the move.** You can feel it. Risk has been hanging in limbo for weeks now, so the lack of new setups reinforces the idea that we’re stuck in rotation purgatory. This isn’t the time to press bets on breakout trades; it’s already been a coin flip. But it’s also not the time to go full-on bearish just because it’s boring. Unless you hate making money. Big money still gets made when nobody’s paying attention. It’s just not in the obvious places.

Let’s talk about that. Look at what’s working: we’re still sitting on a triple-digit move in $COIN, $MP, $UUUU, and $BTU. That’s not just success; that’s *themes*. Rare earths, uranium, crypto, and coal. What do they have in common? They all scream high-beta, high-conviction, and maximum leverage to a squeeze environment. That’s leadership. So if you’re waiting for the next great trend to emerge, you now know where to look when volume comes back. Pay attention—rare earths and uranium don’t start moving for no reason. **The market is whispering about demand for commodities that fuel the next wave of tech AND energy. Are you listening?**

Portfolio-wise, we’re still running lean and mean with a boatload of unrealized gains, but a few new positions are just now waking up. $AFRM is up 54% from our entry—fintech keeps slithering higher even as headlines talk about inflation fears and rising rates. It’s a sneaky group right now. $RCAT and $ONDS, the drone squad, have been solid despite the chop in broader markets. On the flip side, names like $QBTS and $SOUN that we added for exposure have barely moved. Those are your wildcards to watch. If they get squeezed, the beta game is back on, and you’re going to want to be aggressive when it happens.

Looking ahead, today’s close is all about scanning for which sectors are leading into the weekend. If rare earths ($MP, $UAMY) and uranium/nuclear ($UEC, $SMR) keep pushing higher, get ready for some fireworks. And don’t sleep on $GME and $GRPN—sure, they’re meme-adjacent, but both are signaling that the appetite for squeeze plays isn’t dead. Watch for volume spikes and price action into the bell. Something’s brewing; it’s just not ready to boil. Yet.

Risk is on. Full stop. Stay ready.
